answer: Optical-PUF attestation helps an AI-agent economy resist Sybil attacks by binding each agent to a glass prism doped with random pigment inside a secure enclave. Verifiers send wavelength and angle challenges, and the enclave signs the refraction and absorption spectra against its enrolled baseline. Spoofing identities requires fabricating and powering distinct hardware cores. Still, uncooled nodes on an exposed knoll suffer thermal drift that shifts refractive indices and causes false rejections.
